visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through anchors for the ordinary second shift, first-hour preparation, bearing break, mechanical triage, emergency district moot, last-shift allocation, and four state-gated ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Give the empty room geometry, worker routine, first-hour choice, folded preparation state, bearing crack, triage choice, district arrival, final threshold, and each ending family separate visual_scene_id anchors. Let the bronze crescent striking the rail stand as its own pivotal alarm frame.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base prompt restates visible room geometry, material, light, interfaces, and every visible body's appearance and position. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints. Branch and state modifiers describe affirmative visible deltas only.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise dark ink lines with restrained watercolor, worn basalt and limestone, practical brass-and-iron machinery, warm amber oil lamps against cold blue mana light, readable compact silhouettes, expressive faces and hands, humane workplace detail, cinematic composition designed for interactive-fiction replay, surfaces marked with simple abstract runes and unlettered gauges.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each render from the global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups listed as visible in that scene, and every triggered state or global branch modifier. A camera-specific render from the declared scene_set supplies geometry authority for each angle.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one two-level pump room from wide, rail, wet-stair, object-closeup, and public-landing angles. The draft map fixes zones, routes, cameras, sightlines, and branch-state anchors for B-level planning.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of a municipal pump house carved into dark basalt beside a warm underground sea. A rectangular upper dry gallery runs east to west; an arched public doorway and street landing enter at the west end; a brass safety rail lines the south edge around a grated stair opening to the lower wet intake chamber and service floor. Three squat iron pump engines stand west to east below the gallery rail, each with a vertical rod, glass pressure float, long valve extension rising to upper-service reach, dark slate for geometric runes, and red-shouldered isolation wedge throat. A locked brass-and-gold mana conduit arch enters the north gallery wall above the middle engine and glows cold blue. Three thick outlet trunks turn west beneath the public landing. An overhead chain hoist hangs beside the south stair opening. Warm mineral mist rises through the grating. Eight empty chalk squares form a simple water clock on a black board by the public rail. Amber oil lamps reveal worn stone, damp lower grating, bronze filings in a white dish, clean catch trays, and a spare bearing sleeve on a shelf.
visual_continuity_notes: The upper dry gallery runs east-west; its public door is west, the stair descends south through the rail opening, the north wall carries conduit and header board, and the south rail overlooks the lower service floor.
The lower engines remain ordered west-to-east as One, Two, Three; the common intake lies below them and outlet trunks turn west beneath the public landing.

Journeyworker Rada Venn, a compact broad-built dwarf woman with warm umber skin, black hair in a flat crown braid, moss-green wool shirt, brown leather apron, tool belt, and round goggles with one cracked lens pushed onto her brow, counts filings at the rail. Master Kelda Moor, an older deep-brown-skinned dwarf woman with silver-grey braids tucked into an indigo high-collared work coat and a heavy brass civic seal on a black chain, stands beside an unstamped brass inspection plate bordered by a narrow covenant strip with two simple geometric coverage marks. A hot seed-loaf heel passes through the rail between Iven and Rada. Red arcs above the squares show an approaching bakery and laundry peak.

An overhead chain hoist hangs beside the stair opening. Three outlet trunks turn west beneath the public landing.
